sprite.name: FIRE TROOPER
sprite.incarnation: Original MSX2, Outer Heaven Fire Trooper; Same MG1 fully covered cream protective hood, dark round-eye gasmask, original fuel tank/connected hose/held flamethrower, two arms/two legs. Black tailored formal coat/ivory shirt insert over retained sealed protective suit; no uncovered ordinary face. Independent left sheet includes some turned reset/stagger poses; these are not mapped to left active shots. Floor-fire trap uses crouch posture; real ranged shots use actual11 barrel.; original independently authored CQC gala adaptation, not a released canonical costume.
